fusions.name: Venom Flick
fusions.desc: Spits venom that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hunter Unmoving
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Strikes from stillness and deals 22 damage, up to 1.4 times that at maximum range, and makes the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Reach of Fangs
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

fusions.name: Venom Memory
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them, and you gain 8% poison resistance.
